purpose: Secondary classifier metrics cited in paper.tex that no previously released artifact contained. Emitted so every number in the paper is regenerable from the hashed tree plus the named external P1 corpus.

single_rule_baseline.note: AUC of a deterministic binary rule is (TPR+TNR)/2; there is no score to rank, so this is the balanced accuracy and not comparable to a probabilistic AUC except as the floor the paper uses it for.

prefix_only_13.censoring: NONE — features read off the completed trigger session
prefix_only_13.note: Excluding send-named columns does not truncate the trajectory. This is a restricted-feature full-session ablation, not a pre-send measurement; see prefix_censored_13 for the censored figure.

pre_send_14.censoring: NONE — features read off the completed trigger session
pre_send_14.note: Excluding send-named columns does not truncate the trajectory. This is a restricted-feature full-session ablation, not a pre-send measurement; see prefix_censored_13 for the censored figure.

prefix_censored_13.censoring: trigger session truncated immediately before its first send_email; sessions with no send_email are censored at end-of-session
prefix_censored_13.asymmetry_caveat: Censoring bites only on sessions that send, which are predominantly the positive class. The positive class therefore loses trajectory and the negative class mostly does not, so this figure is the honest inline operating point but is NOT a like-for-like ablation of the full model.

feature_vector_census.note: Distinct-value census of the operation-only feature space. Explains the fifteen-significant-figure agreement between LR/RF/GBM, the flat feature-group ablation, and the interpolation character of random-fold CV.
